definitions.gloss: to feel obliged; to feel grateful and apologetic; to be much obliged
definitions.explanation: To feel a mixture of gratitude and apologetic embarrassment when someone does something for you. A key expression of polite Japanese social interaction, expressing that one feels undeserving of the kindness received.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦お{名前|なまえ}→お名前：22188_onamae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: I'm sorry to trouble you, but could I have your name once more?

examples.japanese: ⟦わざわざ→わざわざ：06073_wazawaza⟧⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です。
examples.english: I am much obliged that you went out of your way to come.

examples.japanese: ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な⟦{贈|おく}り{物|もの}→贈り物：01343_okurimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただいて→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、{恐縮|きょうしゅく}して⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: I am deeply grateful and humbled to receive such a wonderful gift.

notes:
Literally "to shrink with fear/awe" — {恐|きょう} (fear, awe) + {縮|しゅく} (shrink). In practice, it expresses the polite Japanese sentiment of feeling undeserving of someone's kindness or effort. Essential for formal and business Japanese.

USAGE:
Most commonly appears as ⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です or ⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧... (I'm sorry to trouble you, but...). The progressive form {恐縮|きょうしゅく}して⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧ is even more formal and humble.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ — I'm sorry to trouble you, but... (polite preface to a request)
- ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です — I am much obliged; very grateful
- ⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧⟦{至極|しごく}→至極：13938_shigoku⟧ — most humbly grateful (very formal)
- {恐縮|きょうしゅく}して⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧ — I am very grateful (humble progressive)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}る→恐れ入る：05914_osoreiru⟧ — to be sorry; to be grateful; similar polite expression, slightly less formal
- ⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ない→申し訳ない：20352_moushiwakenai⟧ — to feel sorry; focuses more on apology than gratitude
- ありがたい — grateful; straightforward gratitude without the apologetic nuance
